title: Add resource limits and security hardening to k8s manifests
description:
**Severity: MEDIUM**

**Files**: `deploy/k8s/base.yaml`, `deploy/k8s/production/backup.yaml`, `deploy/k8s/production/redis.yaml`

Three grouped issues:

1. **Missing resource limits on CronJob/Job containers**:
   - backup.yaml: Redis backup container (lines 28-47) — no requests/limits
   - backup.yaml: NATS backup container (lines 71-95) — no requests/limits
   - redis.yaml: Redis cluster init Job container (lines 103-136) — no requests/limits

2. **Missing container security contexts** (base.yaml, all containers):
   - No `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` on any container
   - No `seccompProfile: RuntimeDefault` on any pod
   - No `fsGroup` in pod security context despite `runAsNonRoot: true`

3. **No ResourceQuota/LimitRange for namespace** (base.yaml:1-6): Namespace can consume unlimited cluster resources.

**Fix**: Add resource requests/limits to all containers. Add container-level security contexts. Consider adding namespace ResourceQuota.
definitionOfDone: All CronJob/Job containers have resource requests and limits
All containers have readOnlyRootFilesystem and seccompProfile
fsGroup added to pod security contexts

implementationPlan.description:
**Add resource limits to CronJob/Job containers**:

- `backup.yaml` redis-backup container (after line 47): `resources: { requests: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi }, limits: { cpu: 200m, memory: 256Mi } }`
- `backup.yaml` nats-backup container (similar location): same resources
- `redis.yaml` redis-init Job container (after line 131): `resources: { requests: { cpu: 50m, memory: 64Mi }, limits: { cpu: 100m, memory: 128Mi } }`

These are short-lived operations so limits can be conservative.

**Add container-level security contexts** to all Cordum service containers in `base.yaml`. For each container add:
```yaml
securityContext:
  readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
  allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
```

Affected containers: context-engine, safety-kernel, scheduler, api-gateway, workflow-engine, dashboard (6 containers). Third-party containers (nats, redis) are left as-is since they may need writable filesystems.

**Add pod-level security hardening** to all Cordum pod specs in `base.yaml`. Update the existing `securityContext` blocks to include:
```yaml
securityContext:
  runAsNonRoot: true
  runAsUser: 65532
  runAsGroup: 65532
  fsGroup: 65532
  seccompProfile:
    type: RuntimeDefault
```
The `runAsNonRoot/runAsUser/runAsGroup` already exist on some pods; add `fsGroup` and `seccompProfile`.
Validate with `kustomize build deploy/k8s/production/` to verify all YAML is valid.
